name: Grater Grilled Cheese
notes: Router screened this out as doubled (67 of 145 rows repeating by name and price across differently-named sections) - re-fetched and confirmed the diagnosis, but it is the documented Toast-duplicate-catalog pattern (rule 8), not an unusable source: the storefront serves two parallel menus (a shorter one and a more granular one splitting the same items into Sides/Salads/Burgers/Drinks/Little Graters/The Sweets/Grater Sauces & Spreads/Make it a Combo!) that overlap almost completely. Deduped globally by exact (name, price) pair, keeping the more granular Menu-B section label where both existed, dropping the 3-item Featured Items carousel (all 3 items - Philly Grilled Cheese, NY Patty Melt, Grater Smash - confirmed present elsewhere by name+price match): 148 raw rows to 78 unique dishes. One item (Basic Fries and Drink $5.49) only appeared in the less-granular menu and was manually filed under Make it a Combo! alongside its five sibling combo rows for consistency - not a price change, a section relabel only. Markup test on the 78 unique prices: 55 end in .99, 13 in .50, 7 in .00 (a handful of odd combo prices .19/.49/.89) - a normal printed-menu distribution; no divisor 1.04-1.30 beats baseline (best 23/78 at 1.25). Price level plausible for 2026 (grilled cheese $14.99-16.99, kids $8.99, sides $0.50-4.99). Sections reached: Basic 5 Build Your Own, Gourmet Grilled Cheese Sandwiches, Chef's Specials, Burgers, Loaded Mac n Cheese or Fries, Make it a Combo!, Sides, Salads, Little Graters (kids), Drinks, The Sweets, Grater Sauces & Spreads, Family Platters - this is the complete catalog, both parallel menus accounted for.
